falsification_contract.HYPOTHESIS: expected effect holds: The transmission system will maintain consistent power delivery and avoid sudden deceleration events caused by electrical supply instability. (recorded prior 0.6, epistemic class MODEL_DERIVED per the killer-experiment provenance)
falsification_contract.TREATMENT: No valid design change can be instantiated because the source mechanism (legislative creation of an electric transmission authority) is categorically incompatible with the target device (Kia Soul mechanical transmission system).
falsification_contract.CONTROL: the physics stage's executed BASELINE_COMPARISON arm (lifecycle verdict BEATS_BASELINE) — the baseline the candidate was measured against in the same evaluation
falsification_contract.MEASUREMENT: Applying the source concept (enactment of HB 2263) to the Kia Soul transmission will result in zero change to the frequency of sudden power loss events.
falsification_contract.APPARATUS_BLOCKER: no separate apparatus record exists; the falsification test does not state a quantified instrumented procedure
falsification_contract.SAMPLE_BLOCKER: no sample-size / n= record exists in any engine stage (honest UNKNOWN — Art. XXV)
falsification_contract.ACCEPTANCE_THRESHOLD_BLOCKER: the recorded expected effect carries no numeric band ('No measurable effect on sudden transmission power loss can be predicted because the causal link between the source evidence and the target failure is non-existe') — a prose expectation is not an acceptance threshold (Art. LII/XXVII: the band is not invented by inference); the candidate must state the measurable quantity and its band
falsification_contract.FALSIFICATION_THRESHOLD_BLOCKER: the kill outcome cannot be stated NUMERICALLY from records: the recorded expected effect carries no numeric band — a prose kill sentence is not a threshold (R478 P0-3; Art. LII/XXVII: the band is not invented)
falsification_contract.UNCERTAINTY: all priors MODEL_DERIVED; no EXPERIMENTALLY_ESTIMATED inputs exist at this stage (Art. XXVIII/XXXVIII: no synthetic shortcut to physical observation)
